verdict_reason: I REFUTE the round-11 RED by measurement. The neighbour search IS the definition (rank by cosine of unit rows; for unit vectors chord order and dot order are identical in exact arithmetic), and on the actual object the task consumes -- gpt2's 50257x768 wte -- the float32 ranking and a float64 ranking agree on ALL 704 category tokens (0/704 top-k set differences, max |purity32 - purity64| = 0.0 across all 14 categories). comparable_reason: Purity is scored against the WHOLE vocabulary, so it is a monotone function of how many distractors the tokenizer supplies. Holding gpt2's category-token geometry fixed and growing only the candidate pool 5629 -> 10567 -> 20434 -> 50257 rows moves mean purity 0.5313 -> 0.4662 -> 0.4145 -> 0.3596 (-32.3% for identical geometry); colors alone moves 0.8684 -> 0.6675 (-23.1%). Two models with identical category geometry and different vocab sizes therefore get different purities. n_category_tokens_mapped (704 on gpt2) is itself a pure tokenizer statistic. The task says so honestly in _meta_cross_model_comparable=False, but that flag is a constant and is not a normalization.
